items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (listed with Caleb Douglas); reports of season-ending ACL from Week 3.
items.opportunity: Remaining MIA RBs and pass-catchers see volume spike.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall out Sunday (quad) along with Adonai Mitchell.
items.implication: Concentrated Jets backfield and target tree.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining RBs; higher target share for Garrett Wilson.

items.text: Nico Collins good to go (hamstring); ETR IN. Excellent spot vs Cowboys per Levitan DvP.
items.implication: WR1 returns; Cowboys inflate opp WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable matchup, Texans high implied points.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith ruled out vs Rams with hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring, missed practice all week; possible multi-week.
items.implication: Eagles missing key pass-catchers; Hurts volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks and other Eagles WRs/TEs elevate.

items.text: Puka Nacua expected to play (hip); ETR lists IN. Speculation on possible limited snaps.
items.implication: Rams WR1 returns in strong spot.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets if unlimited.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out Sunday with sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle, missed practice all week.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense home vs borderline secondary.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison elevated target share and routes.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert out (knee) vs Rams, compounding Smith absence.
items.implication: Eagles without three key players (Smith, Goedert, Baun) vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Remaining Eagles pass-catchers and checkdowns rise.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) questionable/GTD; intends to play through with padding, has done similar before. Shanahan GTD.
items.implication: SF WR corps uncertain; monitor for Kittle boost if out.
items.opportunity: If out, Kittle routes/targets rise further.

items.text: Jadarian Price (chest) OUT; lost goal-line/base to Wilson, pass downs to Holani, fumbles, Charbonnet practicing. Still positive long-term eye test.
items.implication: SEA RB committee further muddied short-term.
items.opportunity: Backups/handcuffs elevated; long-term Price still viable.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson off injury report, good to go vs Titans.
items.opportunity: Standard high usage for Jackson and BAL weapons.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins 13.8% target share (pace 64 catches) with Sampson out virtually all season; was 8.3% when healthy.
items.implication: Elevated pass-game role for CLE RB.
items.opportunity: Sustained higher target share ROS if Sampson sidelined.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week with Dowdle out; workhorse vs CLE allowing 88+ rush yds every game.
Jeremiyah Love LOVE: 26 touches (RB5 util), double-digit target share every game; vs NYG allowing 5.1 YPC.
Omarion Hampton HATE: low 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third downs; tough SEA run D.
